title: weekly-report template variables
description: Values for templates/weekly-report.md.j2 and templates/weekly-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from weekly-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

bottleneck_stage.title: Bottleneck stage
bottleneck_stage.description: The bottleneck stage used under 'Lead Time for Changes'.

cfr_target.title: Cfr target
cfr_target.description: Target change failure rate, and what counts as a failure. Rollback only, or any hotfix within 24h? The threshold is worthless until the reader knows which.

deploy_frequency_target.title: Deploy frequency target
deploy_frequency_target.description: The deployment frequency you are actually aiming for this quarter. Copying "elite" out of the report is how a team measures itself against a benchmark nobody agreed to chase.

lead_time_target.title: Lead time target
lead_time_target.description: Target lead time from first commit to production. State the definition you are using - teams that measure from PR-open instead of first-commit report numbers that are not comparable to anyone's.

list.title: List
list.description: Affected services. From section 'Change Failure Rate'.

longest.title: Longest
longest.description: The longest used under 'Time to Restore (MTTR)'.

longest_lead_time.title: Longest lead time
longest_lead_time.description: The longest lead time used under 'Lead Time for Changes'.

mttr_target.title: Mttr target
mttr_target.description: Target time to restore, measured from customer impact and not from detection. The gap between those two is usually where the real problem is.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Longest lead time. From section 'Lead Time for Changes'.

report_owner.title: Report owner
report_owner.description: Who compiles this and answers for the numbers. Metrics with no author drift into decoration by the third week - somebody has to be embarrassed by a bad one.

root_causes.title: Root causes
root_causes.description: The root causes used under 'Change Failure Rate'.

week_of.title: Week of
week_of.description: Monday of the week reported, ISO. DORA numbers only mean anything as a series, and a series needs every entry to say which week it is without the reader counting back.
